callout.replaced.text: This decision no longer applies: see {links}.
callout.replacement.title: Replacement proposed

register.title: Architecture decisions
register.lede: The architecture decisions of the project, one page per decision. An accepted decision is never rewritten: a new decision supersedes it.
register.to-validate: Deviations from the socle to approve
register.info.purpose: Find each architecture decision and know whether it applies.
register.info.content: One row per ADR: title, status, date, what it supersedes and what supersedes it, the question it answers, deviation from the stack socle.
register.info.why: The ADR register, a sortable table; computed from the pages, it never drifts from them.
register.info.read.propose: {tag} pending: a deviation from the socle goes up to the human through the PO.
register.info.read.remplace: {tag} no longer applies, see the "Superseded by" column.
register.info.source: The meta tags of the pages adr/NNNN-<slug>.html, read by team/scripts/adr-pages.mjs; "Superseded by" is computed from the remplace tag of the superseding decision.
